mistakes.text: She will buy another charm when she will come to this market again.
mistakes.normalized: she will buy another charm when she will come to this market again
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „when“ o budúcnosti patrí Present Simple, nie „will“: „when she comes“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „when“ o budoucnosti patří Present Simple, ne „will“: „when she comes“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “when” referring to the future, use Present Simple, not “will”: “when she comes”.
